title: Efficient and Scalable Physics-Guided Fully Convolutional Spatiotemporal Learning for 3D Microstructure Evolution Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.36504v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate prediction of three-dimensional (3D) microstructure evolution remains computationally demanding because high-fidelity phase-field simulations require repeated numerical integration over large volumetric domains and long temporal horizons. This study develops an efficient and scalable physics-guided fully convolutional spatiotemporal framework for direct multi-frame prediction of complete 3D microstructure sequences. The model combines shared 3D spatial encoding and decoding with a factorized latent translator that integrates temporal, local 3D spatial, and channel interactions. A discrete Cahn--Hilliard (CH) residual is incorporated during training to regularize the learned evolution toward the governing dynamics without altering the inference pathway. translated_title: 高效可扩展的物理引导全卷积时空学习用于三维微观组织演化预测
translated_abstract: 对三维微观组织演化的准确预测在计算上仍然极具挑战性，因为高保真度的相场模拟需要在大型体积域和长时间范围上进行反复的数值积分。本研究开发了一个高效且可扩展的物理引导全卷积时空框架，用于对完整三维微观组织序列进行直接多帧预测。该模型将共享的三维空间编码与解码同分解式潜在转换器相结合，该转换器整合了时间、局部三维空间以及通道间的交互。在训练过程中引入了离散化的Cahn-Hilliard (CH) 残差，使学习到的演化向控制动力学方向进行正则化，同时不改变推理路径。该框架在高分辨率三维失稳分解（spinodal decomposition）轨迹上，于标准、长时间外推以及减少时间上下文等预测场景下进行了评估。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种物理引导的全卷积时空学习框架，通过在训练中引入离散Cahn-Hilliard残差正则化，实现了高效且可扩展的三维微观组织演化完整序列的直接多帧预测。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an efficient and scalable physics-guided fully convolutional spatiotemporal framework that incorporates discrete Cahn-Hilliard residual regularization during training, enabling direct multi-frame prediction of complete 3D microstructure evolution sequences.
